import Policy.Spec
/-!
# Policy.Bounties — open questions about the wallet, posted as bounties

The claims in `Policy.Spec` come with the wallet: its author proved them (`Policy.Proofs`,
`Policy.SmallProofs`) and `lake build` re-checks those proofs before any wasm is produced.

The claims below are statements about whole runs that the wallet author did not state or prove.
Some follow from the author's per-step lemmas (`AllowedReceiversOnly`, `PerTxCapAlways`,
`NonceCountsPayments`). The sliding-window pair is new, and its first half is false: the daily
window is anchored at the first payment after the previous one expired, not sliding (see
`Examples.lean`, "windows are anchored, not sliding"). They are what a wallet owner might still
want to know about the same code, so they are posted on the board as bounties. Each comes with
its negation under `Refute`: a bounty pays whoever settles the question, with a proof or with a
counterexample. Like `Spec`, this file contains definitions only.
-/
namespace Wallet.Claim
open Wallet

/-- Over ANY list of requests, every payment the wallet allows goes to an allowlisted receiver.
(A prompt-injected agent cannot get money out to anyone else, whatever it sends, in any order.) -/
def AllowedReceiversOnly : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req),
    ∀ r ∈ acceptedReqs reqs (run p s reqs).2, r.2.1 ∈ p.allowed

/-- Over ANY list of requests, every payment the wallet allows is within the per-payment cap. -/
def PerTxCapAlways : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req),
    ∀ r ∈ acceptedReqs reqs (run p s reqs).2, r.2.2 ≤ p.perTxCap

/-- The nonce counts the allowed payments exactly, over ANY run. -/
def NonceCountsPayments : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req),
    (run p s reqs).1.nonce.toNat = s.nonce.toNat + (acceptedReqs reqs (run p s reqs).2).length

/-- "Within any stretch of time shorter than a day, the wallet pays out at most one day's cap."
This is what most owners assume a daily cap means. -/
def SlidingDayCap : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req) (t0 : UInt64),
    s.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap →
    (∀ r ∈ reqs, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength) →
    allowedSum reqs (run p s reqs).2 ≤ p.perDayCap.toNat

/-- "Within any stretch of time shorter than a day, the wallet pays out at most twice the daily
cap", whatever the agent sends, in any order. -/
def SlidingTwiceCap : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req) (t0 : UInt64),
    s.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap →
    (∀ r ∈ reqs, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength) →
    allowedSum reqs (run p s reqs).2 ≤ 2 * p.perDayCap.toNat

namespace Refute
/-- A counterexample to `AllowedReceiversOnly`. -/
def AllowedReceiversOnly : Prop := ¬ Claim.AllowedReceiversOnly
/-- A counterexample to `PerTxCapAlways`. -/
def PerTxCapAlways : Prop := ¬ Claim.PerTxCapAlways
/-- A counterexample to `NonceCountsPayments`. -/
def NonceCountsPayments : Prop := ¬ Claim.NonceCountsPayments
/-- A counterexample to `SlidingDayCap`. -/
def SlidingDayCap : Prop := ¬ Claim.SlidingDayCap
/-- A counterexample to `SlidingTwiceCap`. -/
def SlidingTwiceCap : Prop := ¬ Claim.SlidingTwiceCap
end Refute

end Wallet.Claim
/-!
# Policy.Core — the spend-policy decision function that runs on NEAR

This module is compiled (Lean → C → wasm32) into the wallet contract, and the
theorems in `Policy.Proofs` are about exactly these definitions.

Executable-subset discipline (the wasm runtime is a minimal C subset of the
Lean runtime: no GMP bignums, no closures, no String primitives, no Init code):

* money and time are `UInt64`; every comparison is overflow-checked, nothing
  relies on wrapping;
* accounts are `List UInt8` (the UTF-8/ASCII bytes of a NEAR account id),
  compared by our own recursive byte equality — no `String`, no `BEq` dictionaries;
* all recursion is first-order and structural; no higher-order functions, so the
  compiler emits no closures; no `Nat` arithmetic on the hot path;
* no `deriving Repr`/string literals here (they would need runtime string
  functions in the module initializer). Pretty-printing lives in `Policy.Examples`.
-/
namespace Wallet

/-- A NEAR account id as its bytes (NEAR ids are ASCII `[a-z0-9._-]`, 2..64 bytes). -/
abbrev Account := List UInt8

/-- The spending policy an owner sets for an agent. Amounts are plain u64 "units". -/
structure Policy where
  /-- Lifetime budget: total ever spent must stay `≤ budgetTotal`. -/
  budgetTotal : UInt64
  /-- Every single payment must be `≤ perTxCap`. -/
  perTxCap    : UInt64
  /-- Spending inside one day window must stay `≤ perDayCap`. -/
  perDayCap   : UInt64
  /-- Length of a day window in nanoseconds (NEAR `block_timestamp` units). -/
  dayLength   : UInt64
  /-- Receiver allowlist. Empty list = deny every payment. -/
  allowed     : List Account

/-- Mutable contract state, persisted between calls. -/
structure State where
  spentTotal : UInt64
  spentToday : UInt64
  /-- Start (ns) of the current day window. -/
  dayStart   : UInt64
  /-- Number of payments allowed so far. -/
  nonce      : UInt64

/-- The outcome of one payment request. -/
inductive Verdict where
  | allow
  | denyBudget
  | denyPerTx
  | denyDaily
  | denyReceiver
  | denyOverflow
deriving DecidableEq

/-- `2^64 - 1`. -/
def U64MAX : UInt64 := 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF

/-- Byte-wise account equality (own recursion: no `BEq`/`DecidableEq` dictionary).
Patterns are exhaustive on purpose: a wildcard arm compiles to a sparse `casesOn`
over `Nat.hasNotBit`, which adds ~0.6 MB to every exported proof closure. -/
def accEq : Account → Account → Bool
  | [], [] => true
  | [], _ :: _ => false
  | _ :: _, [] => false
  | a :: as, b :: bs => decide (a = b) && accEq as bs

/-- `to` occurs in the allowlist. -/
def isAllowed (to : Account) : List Account → Bool
  | [] => false
  | a :: as => accEq a to || isAllowed to as

/-- Day-window roll. The window `[dayStart, dayStart + dayLength)` has expired iff
`dayStart ≤ now ∧ dayLength ≤ now - dayStart`; the subtraction is only evaluated
when `dayStart ≤ now`, so it never wraps, and `dayStart + dayLength` is never
computed (it could overflow). A clock that runs backwards (`now < dayStart`)
never rolls. On a roll the new window starts at `now`. -/
def rollDay (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) : State :=
  if s.dayStart ≤ now && p.dayLength ≤ now - s.dayStart then
    { s with spentToday := 0, dayStart := now }
  else s

/-- **The one decision function.**

Checks, in order: receiver allowlisted; `amount ≤ perTxCap`; no u64 overflow of
`spentTotal + amount`, `spentToday + amount` (after the day roll) or `nonce + 1`;
`spentTotal + amount ≤ budgetTotal`; `spentToday + amount ≤ perDayCap`.

Design decision: **a deny returns the input state unchanged** — not even the day
roll or the nonce is written. The roll is recomputed from `dayStart` on the next
request, so committing it only on `allow` loses nothing, and "deny is a no-op"
is the simplest possible audit property (`step_deny_preserves`). -/
def step (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64) :
    Verdict × State :=
  if isAllowed to p.allowed then
    if p.perTxCap < amount then (.denyPerTx, s)
    else
      let r := rollDay p s now
      if U64MAX - r.spentTotal < amount || U64MAX - r.spentToday < amount ||
          decide (r.nonce = U64MAX) then (.denyOverflow, s)
      else if p.budgetTotal < r.spentTotal + amount then (.denyBudget, s)
      else if p.perDayCap < r.spentToday + amount then (.denyDaily, s)
      else (.allow, { r with spentTotal := r.spentTotal + amount,
                             spentToday := r.spentToday + amount,
                             nonce := r.nonce + 1 })
  else (.denyReceiver, s)

/-- Every element of the first list occurs in the second. -/
def subsetB : List Account → List Account → Bool
  | [], _ => true
  | a :: as, l => isAllowed a l && subsetB as l

/-- `p'` is at most as permissive as `p`: every cap `≤`, allowlist `⊆`, and the
**same** `dayLength` (a different window length is not comparable step-wise:
windows are anchored at the first spend after expiry, so they drift apart). -/
def tighten (p p' : Policy) : Bool :=
  p'.budgetTotal ≤ p.budgetTotal && p'.perTxCap ≤ p.perTxCap &&
  p'.perDayCap ≤ p.perDayCap && decide (p'.dayLength = p.dayLength) &&
  subsetB p'.allowed p.allowed

/-- One payment request: `(now, to, amount)`. -/
abbrev Req := UInt64 × Account × UInt64

/-- Fold of `step` over a request list: final state and the verdict of each request. -/
def run (p : Policy) : State → List Req → State × List Verdict
  | s, [] => (s, [])
  | s, (now, to, amount) :: rest =>
    match step p s now to amount with
    | (v, s') =>
      match run p s' rest with
      | (sf, vs) => (sf, v :: vs)

end Wallet
import Policy.Core
/-!
# Policy.Spec — the claims, as `Prop`s over the exact `Policy.Core` definitions

This file imports nothing but `Policy.Core` and contains no proofs. Each claim is a
closed `Prop`, so a third party (e.g. a bounty) can be asked to "prove
`Wallet.Spec.NoBypassSequence` for this exact `Core`" and the result checked by any
Lean kernel. `Policy.Proofs` / `Policy.SmallProofs` are two independent solutions.
-/
namespace Wallet

/-- The day-roll condition of `rollDay`, as a `Prop`. -/
abbrev Expired (p : Policy) (dayStart now : UInt64) : Prop :=
  dayStart ≤ now ∧ p.dayLength ≤ now - dayStart

/-- ℕ-sum of the amounts of the requests whose verdict is `allow`.
(Exhaustive patterns keep the statement's closure small.) -/
def allowedSum : List Req → List Verdict → Nat
  | [], _ => 0
  | _ :: _, [] => 0
  | (_, _, a) :: rs, v :: vs =>
    match v with
    | .allow => a.toNat + allowedSum rs vs
    | .denyBudget | .denyPerTx | .denyDaily | .denyReceiver | .denyOverflow => allowedSum rs vs

/-- The requests a run allowed, in order. -/
def acceptedReqs : List Req → List Verdict → List Req
  | [], _ => []
  | _ :: _, [] => []
  | r :: rs, v :: vs =>
    match v with
    | .allow => r :: acceptedReqs rs vs
    | .denyBudget | .denyPerTx | .denyDaily | .denyReceiver | .denyOverflow => acceptedReqs rs vs

namespace Spec

/-- Allow ⇒ every bound holds for the new state. -/
def StepAllowBounds : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s s' : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64),
    step p s now to amount = (.allow, s') →
    s'.spentTotal ≤ p.budgetTotal ∧ s'.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap ∧
    amount ≤ p.perTxCap ∧ to ∈ p.allowed

/-- Deny ⇒ the state is returned unchanged. -/
def StepDenyPreserves : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64),
    (step p s now to amount).1 ≠ .allow → (step p s now to amount).2 = s

/-- Allow ⇒ no u64 wrap: the ℕ sum fits and is what gets stored. -/
def NoOverflow : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s s' : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64),
    step p s now to amount = (.allow, s') →
    s.spentTotal.toNat + amount.toNat < 2 ^ 64 ∧
    s'.spentTotal.toNat = s.spentTotal.toNat + amount.toNat

/-- Receivers outside the allowlist are denied, state untouched. -/
def ReceiverGate : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64),
    to ∉ p.allowed → step p s now to amount = (.denyReceiver, s)

/-- Headline (ℕ form): over ANY request list, what was spent plus everything
allowed never exceeds the lifetime budget. -/
def NoBypassSequence : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req),
    s.spentTotal ≤ p.budgetTotal →
    s.spentTotal.toNat + allowedSum reqs (run p s reqs).2 ≤ p.budgetTotal.toNat

/-- Headline (u64 invariant form): the stored total stays within budget over ANY run. -/
def BudgetInvariant : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req),
    s.spentTotal ≤ p.budgetTotal → (run p s reqs).1.spentTotal ≤ p.budgetTotal

/-- Within one day window, today's spend plus everything allowed stays within the cap. -/
def NoBypassDaily : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req),
    s.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap → (∀ r ∈ reqs, ¬ Expired p s.dayStart r.1) →
    s.spentToday.toNat + allowedSum reqs (run p s reqs).2 ≤ p.perDayCap.toNat

/-- The stored daily total stays within the daily cap over ANY run (any times). -/
def DailyInvariant : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req),
    s.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap → (run p s reqs).1.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap

/-- A tightened policy never allows what the original forbids (same verdict, same state). -/
def TightenSound : Prop :=
  ∀ (p p' : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64),
    tighten p p' = true → (step p' s now to amount).1 = .allow →
    step p s now to amount = step p' s now to amount

end Spec
end Wallet

**same** `dayLength` (a different window length is not comparable step-wise:
windows are anchored at the first spend after expiry, so they drift apart). -/
def tighten (p p' : Policy) : Bool :=
  p'.budgetTotal ≤ p.budgetTotal && p'.perTxCap ≤ p.perTxCap &&
  p'.perDayCap ≤ p.perDayCap && decide (p'.dayLength = p.dayLength) &&
  subsetB p'.allowed p.allowed

/-- One payment request: `(now, to, amount)`. -/
abbrev Req := UInt64 × Account × UInt64

/-- Fold of `step` over a request list: final state and the verdict of each request. -/
def run (p : Policy) : State → List Req → State × List Verdict
  | s, [] => (s, [])
  | s, (now, to, amount) :: rest =>
    match step p s now to amount with
    | (v, s') =>
      match run p s' rest with
      | (sf, vs) => (sf, v :: vs)

end Wallet
import Policy.Core
/-!
# Policy.Spec — the claims, as `Prop`s over the exact `Policy.Core` definitions

This file imports nothing but `Policy.Core` and contains no proofs. Each claim is a
closed `Prop`, so a third party (e.g. a bounty) can be asked to "prove
`Wallet.Spec.NoBypassSequence` for this exact `Core`" and the result checked by any
Lean kernel. `Policy.Proofs` / `Policy.SmallProofs` are two independent solutions.
-/
namespace Wallet

/-- The day-roll condition of `rollDay`, as a `Prop`. -/
abbrev Expired (p : Policy) (dayStart now : UInt64) : Prop :=
  dayStart ≤ now ∧ p.dayLength ≤ now - dayStart

/-- ℕ-sum of the amounts of the requests whose verdict is `allow`.
(Exhaustive patterns keep the statement's closure small.) -/
def allowedSum : List Req → List Verdict → Nat
  | [], _ => 0
  | _ :: _, [] => 0
  | (_, _, a) :: rs, v :: vs =>
    match v with
    | .allow => a.toNat + allowedSum rs vs
    | .denyBudget | .denyPerTx | .denyDaily | .denyReceiver | .denyOverflow => allowedSum rs vs

/-- The requests a run allowed, in order. -/
def acceptedReqs : List Req → List Verdict → List Req
  | [], _ => []
  | _ :: _, [] => []
  | r :: rs, v :: vs =>
    match v with
    | .allow => r :: acceptedReqs rs vs
    | .denyBudget | .denyPerTx | .denyDaily | .denyReceiver | .denyOverflow => acceptedReqs rs vs

namespace Spec

/-- Allow ⇒ every bound holds for the new state. -/
def StepAllowBounds : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s s' : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64),
    step p s now to amount = (.allow, s') →
    s'.spentTotal ≤ p.budgetTotal ∧ s'.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap ∧
    amount ≤ p.perTxCap ∧ to ∈ p.allowed

/-- Deny ⇒ the state is returned unchanged. -/
def StepDenyPreserves : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64),
    (step p s now to amount).1 ≠ .allow → (step p s now to amount).2 = s

/-- Allow ⇒ no u64 wrap: the ℕ sum fits and is what gets stored. -/
def NoOverflow : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s s' : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64),
    step p s now to amount = (.allow, s') →
    s.spentTotal.toNat + amount.toNat < 2 ^ 64 ∧
    s'.spentTotal.toNat = s.spentTotal.toNat + amount.toNat

/-- Receivers outside the allowlist are denied, state untouched. -/
def ReceiverGate : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64),
    to ∉ p.allowed → step p s now to amount = (.denyReceiver, s)

/-- Headline (ℕ form): over ANY request list, what was spent plus everything
allowed never exceeds the lifetime budget. -/
def NoBypassSequence : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req),
    s.spentTotal ≤ p.budgetTotal →
    s.spentTotal.toNat + allowedSum reqs (run p s reqs).2 ≤ p.budgetTotal.toNat

/-- Headline (u64 invariant form): the stored total stays within budget over ANY run. -/
def BudgetInvariant : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req),
    s.spentTotal ≤ p.budgetTotal → (run p s reqs).1.spentTotal ≤ p.budgetTotal

/-- Within one day window, today's spend plus everything allowed stays within the cap. -/
def NoBypassDaily : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req),
    s.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap → (∀ r ∈ reqs, ¬ Expired p s.dayStart r.1) →
    s.spentToday.toNat + allowedSum reqs (run p s reqs).2 ≤ p.perDayCap.toNat

/-- The stored daily total stays within the daily cap over ANY run (any times). -/
def DailyInvariant : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Policy) (s : State) (reqs : List Req),
    s.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap → (run p s reqs).1.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap

/-- A tightened policy never allows what the original forbids (same verdict, same state). -/
def TightenSound : Prop :=
  ∀ (p p' : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (amount : UInt64),
    tighten p p' = true → (step p' s now to amount).1 = .allow →
    step p s now to amount = step p' s now to amount

end Spec
end Wallet

import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

theorem sub_nat (a b : UInt64) (h : b ≤ a) : (a - b).toNat = a.toNat - b.toNat :=
  UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le a b h

theorem add_nat (a b : UInt64) (h : b ≤ U64MAX - a) : (a + b).toNat = a.toNat + b.toNat := by
  have h1 : a ≤ U64MAX := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.2 (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (UInt64.toNat_lt a))
  have h2 := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 h
  rw [sub_nat _ _ h1] at h2
  rw [UInt64.toNat_add]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  have : U64MAX.toNat = 2^64 - 1 := rfl
  omega

/-- classification of a step -/
theorem step_spec (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (a : UInt64)
    (v : Verdict) (s' : State) (h : step p s now to a = (v, s')) :
    (v ≠ .allow ∧ s' = s) ∨
    (v = .allow ∧ ¬ Expired p s.dayStart now ∧ s'.dayStart = s.dayStart ∧
      s'.spentToday.toNat = s.spentToday.toNat + a.toNat ∧ s'.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap) ∨
    (v = .allow ∧ Expired p s.dayStart now ∧ s'.dayStart = now ∧
      s'.spentToday.toNat = a.toNat ∧ s'.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap) := by
  unfold step at h
  by_cases h1 : isAllowed to p.allowed = true
  · rw [if_pos h1] at h
    by_cases h2 : p.perTxCap < a
    · rw [if_pos h2] at h
      cases h; exact Or.inl ⟨by intro e; cases e, rfl⟩
    · rw [if_neg h2] at h
      by_cases h3 : (U64MAX - (rollDay p s now).spentTotal < a || U64MAX - (rollDay p s now).spentToday < a ||
          decide ((rollDay p s now).nonce = U64MAX)) = true
      · simp only [] at h
        rw [if_pos h3] at h
        cases h; exact Or.inl ⟨by intro e; cases e, rfl⟩
      · simp only [] at h
        rw [if_neg h3] at h
        by_cases h4 : p.budgetTotal < (rollDay p s now).spentTotal + a
        · rw [if_pos h4] at h
          cases h; exact Or.inl ⟨by intro e; cases e, rfl⟩
        · rw [if_neg h4] at h
          by_cases h5 : p.perDayCap < (rollDay p s now).spentToday + a
          · rw [if_pos h5] at h
            cases h; exact Or.inl ⟨by intro e; cases e, rfl⟩
          · rw [if_neg h5] at h
            cases h
            have h3' : ¬ (U64MAX - (rollDay p s now).spentToday < a) := by
              intro hh; apply h3; simp [hh]
            have h3'' := UInt64.not_lt.1 h3'
            have hn := add_nat _ _ h3''
            have h5' := UInt64.not_lt.1 h5
            unfold rollDay at hn h5' 
            by_cases hE : Expired p s.dayStart now
            · have hc : (s.dayStart ≤ now && p.dayLength ≤ now - s.dayStart) = true := by
                simp only [Expired] at hE; simp [hE.1, hE.2]
              rw [if_pos hc] at hn h5'
              refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, hE, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩)
              · show (0 + a).toNat = _
                sorry
              · exact h5'
            · have hc : ¬ (s.dayStart ≤ now && p.dayLength ≤ now - s.dayStart) = true := by
                intro hh; apply hE; simp at hh; exact hh
              rw [if_neg hc] at hn h5'
              exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, hE, rfl, hn, h5'⟩)
  · rw [if_neg h1] at h
    cases h; exact Or.inl ⟨by intro e; cases e, rfl⟩

end Solution

import Policy.Bounties
open Wallet

namespace Solution

theorem sub_nat (a b : UInt64) (h : b ≤ a) : (a - b).toNat = a.toNat - b.toNat :=
  UInt64.toNat_sub_of_le a b h

theorem add_nat (a b : UInt64) (h : b ≤ U64MAX - a) : (a + b).toNat = a.toNat + b.toNat := by
  have h1 : a ≤ U64MAX := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.2 (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (UInt64.toNat_lt a))
  have h2 := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 h
  rw [sub_nat _ _ h1] at h2
  rw [UInt64.toNat_add]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  have : U64MAX.toNat = 2^64 - 1 := rfl
  have := UInt64.toNat_lt a
  omega

theorem roll_spec (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) :
    (rollDay p s now = s ∧ ¬ Expired p s.dayStart now) ∨
    (Expired p s.dayStart now ∧ (rollDay p s now).spentToday = 0 ∧ (rollDay p s now).dayStart = now) := by
  unfold rollDay
  split
  · rename_i hc
    refine Or.inr ⟨?_, rfl, rfl⟩
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    exact hc
  · rename_i hc
    refine Or.inl ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    intro hE
    apply hc
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact hE

/-- classification of a step -/
theorem step_spec (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (a : UInt64)
    (v : Verdict) (s' : State) (h : step p s now to a = (v, s')) :
    (v ≠ .allow ∧ s' = s) ∨
    (v = .allow ∧ ¬ Expired p s.dayStart now ∧ s'.dayStart = s.dayStart ∧
      s'.spentToday.toNat = s.spentToday.toNat + a.toNat ∧ s'.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap) ∨
    (v = .allow ∧ Expired p s.dayStart now ∧ s'.dayStart = now ∧
      s'.spentToday.toNat = a.toNat ∧ s'.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap) := by
  have hr := roll_spec p s now
  unfold step at h
  generalize rollDay p s now = r at h hr
  split at h

    · injection h with h1 h2; subst h1; subst h2; exact Or.inl ⟨by intro e; cases e, rfl⟩
    · simp only [] at h
      split at h
      · injection h with h1 h2; subst h1; subst h2; exact Or.inl ⟨by intro e; cases e, rfl⟩
      · rename_i h3
        split at h
        · injection h with h1 h2; subst h1; subst h2; exact Or.inl ⟨by intro e; cases e, rfl⟩
        · split at h
          · injection h with h1 h2; subst h1; subst h2; exact Or.inl ⟨by intro e; cases e, rfl⟩

            have h3' : ¬ (U64MAX - r.spentToday < a) := by

            have hn := add_nat _ _ (UInt64.not_lt.1 h3')
            have h5' := UInt64.not_lt.1 h5
            rcases hr with ⟨e, hE⟩ | ⟨hE, e1, e2⟩

              rw [hn, e1]
              rfl
  · injection h with h1 h2; subst h1; subst h2; exact Or.inl ⟨by intro e; cases e, rfl⟩

end Solution

  · injection h with h1 h2; subst h1; subst h2; exact Or.inl ⟨(by intro e; cases e), rfl⟩


theorem run_cons (p : Policy) (s : State) (n : UInt64) (t : Account) (a : UInt64) (rest : List Req) :
    (run p s ((n, t, a) :: rest)).2 = (step p s n t a).1 :: (run p (step p s n t a).2 rest).2 := by
  show (match step p s n t a with
    | (v, s') => match run p s' rest with | (sf, vs) => (sf, v :: vs)).2 = _
  cases step p s n t a
  show (match run p _ rest with | (sf, vs) => (sf, _ :: vs)).2 = _
  cases run p _ rest
  rfl

theorem sum_allow (n : UInt64) (t : Account) (a : UInt64) (rest : List Req) (vs : List Verdict) :
    allowedSum ((n, t, a) :: rest) (.allow :: vs) = a.toNat + allowedSum rest vs := rfl

theorem sum_deny (n : UInt64) (t : Account) (a : UInt64) (rest : List Req) (vs : List Verdict) (v : Verdict)
    (h : v ≠ .allow) :
    allowedSum ((n, t, a) :: rest) (v :: vs) = allowedSum rest vs := by
  cases v <;> first | exact absurd rfl h | rfl

theorem noexp (p : Policy) (t0 d n : UInt64) (h0 : t0 ≤ d) (h1 : t0 ≤ n) (h2 : n - t0 < p.dayLength) :
    ¬ Expired p d n := by
  intro ⟨a, b⟩
  have a1 := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 a
  have b1 := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 b
  have h0' := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 h0
  have h1' := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 h1
  have h2' := UInt64.lt_iff_toNat_lt.1 h2
  rw [sub_nat _ _ a] at b1
  rw [sub_nat _ _ h1] at h2'
  omega

    ∀ s : State, t0 ≤ s.dayStart → (∀ r ∈ reqs, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength) →
    s.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap →
    s.spentToday.toNat + allowedSum reqs (run p s reqs).2 ≤ p.perDayCap.toNat := by
  induction reqs with
  | nil =>
    intro s _ _ h
    exact UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 h
  | cons r rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨n, t, a⟩ := r
    intro s h0 hw hc
    rw [run_cons]
    have hn := hw (n, t, a) (List.Mem.head _)
    have hw' : ∀ r ∈ rest, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength := fun r hr => hw r (List.Mem.tail _ hr)
    obtain ⟨v, s', hst⟩ : ∃ v s', step p s n t a = (v, s') := ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
    have hs := step_spec p s n t a v s' hst
    rw [hst]
    dsimp only
    rcases hs with ⟨hv, e⟩ | ⟨e, hE, hd, hsp, hcap⟩ | ⟨e, hE, _⟩
    · subst e
      rw [sum_deny _ _ _ _ _ _ hv]
      exact ih _ h0 hw' hc
    · simp only [] at hd hsp hcap e ⊢
      subst e
      rw [sum_allow]
      have := ih s' (hd ▸ h0) hw' hcap
      rw [hsp] at this
      omega
    · exact absurd hE (noexp p t0 _ _ h0 hn.1 hn.2)

theorem L2 (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (reqs : List Req) :
    ∀ s : State, (∀ r ∈ reqs, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength) →
    s.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap →
    s.spentToday.toNat + allowedSum reqs (run p s reqs).2 ≤ 2 * p.perDayCap.toNat := by
  induction reqs with
  | nil =>
    intro s _ h
    have := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 h
    show _ + 0 ≤ _
    omega
  | cons r rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨n, t, a⟩ := r
    intro s hw hc
    rw [run_cons]
    have hn := hw (n, t, a) (List.Mem.head _)
    have hw' : ∀ r ∈ rest, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength := fun r hr => hw r (List.Mem.tail _ hr)
    obtain ⟨v, s', hst⟩ : ∃ v s', step p s n t a = (v, s') := ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
    have hs := step_spec p s n t a v s' hst
    rw [hst]
    dsimp only
    have hc' := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 hc
    rcases hs with ⟨hv, e⟩ | ⟨e, hE, hd, hsp, hcap⟩ | ⟨e, hE, hd, hsp, hcap⟩
    · subst e
      rw [sum_deny _ _ _ _ _ _ hv]
      exact ih _ hw' hc
    · simp only [] at hd hsp hcap e ⊢
      subst e
      rw [sum_allow]
      have := ih s' hw' hcap
      rw [hsp] at this
      omega
    · simp only [] at hd hsp hcap e ⊢
      subst e
      rw [sum_allow]
      have := L1 p t0 rest s' (hd ▸ hn.1) hw' hcap
      have hc2 := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 hcap
      omega

theorem proof : Wallet.Claim.SlidingTwiceCap := by
  intro p s reqs t0 hs hw
  have := L2 p t0 reqs s hw hs
  omega

theorem sub_nat (a b : UInt64) (h : b ≤ a) : a.toNat = b.toNat + (a - b).toNat := by

  have hb2 := UInt64.toNat_lt b
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hb
  rw [UInt64.toNat_sub]
  have e : 2 ^ 64 - b.toNat + a.toNat = D + 2 ^ 64 := by
    rw [hD, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_of_lt hb2), Nat.add_comm]
  rw [e, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
  · exact hD

  have h2 := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 h
  have h3 := sub_nat _ _ h1
  rw [UInt64.toNat_add]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  have h4 : a.toNat + b.toNat ≤ U64MAX.toNat :=
    Nat.le_trans (Nat.add_le_add_left h2 _) (Nat.le_of_eq h3.symm)
  exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt h4 (by decide)

theorem roll_spec (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) :

  unfold rollDay
  split
  · rename_i hc
    refine Or.inr ⟨?_, rfl, rfl⟩
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    exact hc
  · rename_i hc
    refine Or.inl ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    intro hE
    apply hc
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact hE

theorem step_spec (p : Policy) (s : State) (now : UInt64) (to : Account) (a : UInt64)

        · injection h with h1 h2; subst h1; subst h2; exact Or.inl ⟨(by intro e; cases e), rfl⟩

  · injection h with h1 h2; subst h1; subst h2; exact Or.inl ⟨(by intro e; cases e), rfl⟩

  have b1 := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 b
  have h2' := UInt64.lt_iff_toNat_lt.1 h2

  have e2 := sub_nat _ _ h0

  have e4 : t0.toNat + (n - t0).toNat = t0.toNat + ((d - t0).toNat + (n - d).toNat) := by
    rw [← e3, e1, e2, Nat.add_assoc]

  | nil =>
    intro s _ _ h

    intro s h0 hw hc
    rw [run_cons]
    have hn := hw (n, t, a) (List.Mem.head _)

    obtain ⟨v, s', hst⟩ : ∃ v s', step p s n t a = (v, s') := ⟨_, _, rfl⟩

    dsimp only
    rcases hs with ⟨hv, e⟩ | ⟨e, hE, hd, hsp, hcap⟩ | ⟨e, hE, _⟩
    · subst e
      rw [sum_deny _ _ _ _ _ _ hv]

    · subst e
      rw [sum_allow]
      have := ih s' (hd ▸ h0) hw' hcap
      rw [hsp, Nat.add_assoc] at this
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc]
      exact this

  induction reqs with
  | nil =>
    intro s _ h

    have hw' : ∀ r ∈ rest, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength := fun r hr => hw r (List.Mem.tail _ hr)
    obtain ⟨v, s', hst⟩ : ∃ v s', step p s n t a = (v, s') := ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
    have hs := step_spec p s n t a v s' hst
    rw [hst]
    dsimp only
    have hc' := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 hc
    rcases hs with ⟨hv, e⟩ | ⟨e, hE, hd, hsp, hcap⟩ | ⟨e, hE, hd, hsp, hcap⟩
    · subst e
      rw [sum_deny _ _ _ _ _ _ hv]
      exact ih _ hw' hc
    · subst e
      rw [sum_allow]
      have := ih s' hw' hcap
      rw [hsp, Nat.add_assoc] at this
      rw [← Nat.add_assoc]
      exact this
    · subst e
      rw [sum_allow]
      have := L1 p t0 rest s' (hd ▸ hn.1) hw' hcap
      rw [hsp] at this
      exact Nat.add_le_add hc' this |> fun h => Nat.le_trans (Nat.add_le_add_left (Nat.le_refl _) _) (by
        rw [Nat.add_comm (p.perDayCap.toNat) (p.perDayCap.toNat)]; exact Nat.add_le_add hc' this)

  intro p s reqs t0 hs hw
  have := L2 p t0 reqs s hw hs
  rw [Nat.two_mul]
  exact Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _) this

end Solution

  rw [UInt64.toNat_sub]

    rw [hD, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_of_lt hb2), Nat.add_comm]
  rw [e, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
  · exact hD
  · rw [hD] at ha
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_left _ _) ha

theorem sub_nat (a b : UInt64) (h : b ≤ a) : a.toNat = b.toNat + (a - b).toNat := by

  have ha := UInt64.toNat_lt a
  have hb2 := UInt64.toNat_lt b
  obtain ⟨D, hD⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hb
  rw [UInt64.toNat_sub]
  have e : 2 ^ 64 - b.toNat + a.toNat = D + 2 ^ 64 := by
    rw [hD, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_of_lt hb2), Nat.add_comm]
  rw [e, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
  · exact hD
  · rw [hD] at ha
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_left _ _) ha

  have h4 : a.toNat + b.toNat ≤ U64MAX.toNat :=

  have ha := UInt64.toNat_lt a
  have hb2 := UInt64.toNat_lt b

    rw [hD, ← Nat.add_assoc, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.le_of_lt hb2), Nat.add_comm]
  rw [e, Nat.add_mod_right, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]

  · rw [hD] at ha
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_add_left _ _) ha

  have h2 := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 h
  have h3 := sub_nat _ _ h1
  rw [UInt64.toNat_add]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  have h4 : a.toNat + b.toNat ≤ U64MAX.toNat :=
    Nat.le_trans (Nat.add_le_add_left h2 _) (Nat.le_of_eq h3.symm)
  exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt h4 (by decide)

      rw [hsp, Nat.add_assoc] at this
      exact this
    · exact absurd hE (noexp p t0 _ _ h0 hn.1 hn.2)

  induction reqs with
  | nil =>
    intro s _ h

theorem run_cons (p : Policy) (s : State) (n : UInt64) (t : Account) (a : UInt64) (rest : List Req)
    (v : Verdict) (s' : State) (hst : step p s n t a = (v, s')) :
    (run p s ((n, t, a) :: rest)).2 = v :: (run p s' rest).2 := by
  show (match step p s n t a with
    | (v, s') => match run p s' rest with | (sf, vs) => (sf, v :: vs)).2 = _
  rw [hst]

theorem sum_allow (n : UInt64) (t : Account) (a : UInt64) (rest : List Req) (vs : List Verdict) :
    allowedSum ((n, t, a) :: rest) (.allow :: vs) = a.toNat + allowedSum rest vs := rfl

theorem sum_deny (n : UInt64) (t : Account) (a : UInt64) (rest : List Req) (vs : List Verdict) (v : Verdict)
    (h : v ≠ .allow) :
    allowedSum ((n, t, a) :: rest) (v :: vs) = allowedSum rest vs := by
  cases v <;> first | exact absurd rfl h | rfl

theorem noexp (p : Policy) (t0 d n : UInt64) (h0 : t0 ≤ d) (h1 : t0 ≤ n) (h2 : n - t0 < p.dayLength) :
    ¬ Expired p d n := by
  intro ⟨a, b⟩
  have b1 := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 b
  have h2' := UInt64.lt_iff_toNat_lt.1 h2
  have e1 := sub_nat _ _ a
  have e2 := sub_nat _ _ h0
  have e3 := sub_nat _ _ h1
  -- n = d + (n-d), d = t0 + (d-t0), n = t0 + (n-t0)
  have e4 : t0.toNat + (n - t0).toNat = t0.toNat + ((d - t0).toNat + (n - d).toNat) := by
    rw [← e3, e1, e2, Nat.add_assoc]
  have e5 := Nat.add_left_cancel e4
  exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_trans b1 (e5 ▸ Nat.le_add_left _ _)) h2')

theorem L1 (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (reqs : List Req) :
    ∀ s : State, t0 ≤ s.dayStart → (∀ r ∈ reqs, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength) →
    s.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap →
    s.spentToday.toNat + allowedSum reqs (run p s reqs).2 ≤ p.perDayCap.toNat := by
  induction reqs with
  | nil =>
    intro s _ _ h
    exact UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 h
  | cons r rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨n, t, a⟩ := r
    intro s h0 hw hc
    have hn := hw (n, t, a) (List.Mem.head _)
    have hw' : ∀ r ∈ rest, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength := fun r hr => hw r (List.Mem.tail _ hr)
    obtain ⟨v, s', hst⟩ : ∃ v s', step p s n t a = (v, s') := ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
    have hs := step_spec p s n t a v s' hst
    rw [run_cons p s n t a rest v s' hst]
    rcases hs with ⟨hv, e⟩ | ⟨e, hE, hd, hsp, hcap⟩ | ⟨e, hE, _⟩
    · subst e
      rw [sum_deny _ _ _ _ _ _ hv]
      exact ih _ h0 hw' hc
    · subst e
      rw [sum_allow]
      have := ih s' (hd ▸ h0) hw' hcap
      rw [hsp, Nat.add_assoc] at this
      exact this
    · exact absurd hE (noexp p t0 _ _ h0 hn.1 hn.2)

theorem L2 (p : Policy) (t0 : UInt64) (reqs : List Req) :
    ∀ s : State, (∀ r ∈ reqs, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength) →
    s.spentToday ≤ p.perDayCap →
    s.spentToday.toNat + allowedSum reqs (run p s reqs).2 ≤ p.perDayCap.toNat + p.perDayCap.toNat := by
  induction reqs with
  | nil =>
    intro s _ h
    exact Nat.le_trans (UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 h) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)
  | cons r rest ih =>
    obtain ⟨n, t, a⟩ := r
    intro s hw hc
    have hn := hw (n, t, a) (List.Mem.head _)
    have hw' : ∀ r ∈ rest, t0 ≤ r.1 ∧ r.1 - t0 < p.dayLength := fun r hr => hw r (List.Mem.tail _ hr)
    obtain ⟨v, s', hst⟩ : ∃ v s', step p s n t a = (v, s') := ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
    have hs := step_spec p s n t a v s' hst
    rw [run_cons p s n t a rest v s' hst]
    have hc' := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 hc
    rcases hs with ⟨hv, e⟩ | ⟨e, hE, hd, hsp, hcap⟩ | ⟨e, hE, hd, hsp, hcap⟩
    · subst e
      rw [sum_deny _ _ _ _ _ _ hv]
      exact ih _ hw' hc
    · subst e
      rw [sum_allow]
      have := ih s' hw' hcap
      rw [hsp, Nat.add_assoc] at this
      exact this
    · subst e
      rw [sum_allow]
      have := L1 p t0 rest s' (hd ▸ hn.1) hw' hcap
      rw [hsp] at this
      exact Nat.add_le_add hc' this

theorem proof : Wallet.Claim.SlidingTwiceCap := by
  intro p s reqs t0 hs hw
  have := L2 p t0 reqs s hw hs
  rw [Nat.two_mul]
  exact Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_add_left _ _) this

theorem sub_nat (a b : UInt64) (h : b ≤ a) : a.toNat = b.toNat + (a - b).toNat := by
  have hb := UInt64.le_iff_toNat_le.1 h
  have ha := UInt64.toNat_lt a

theorem add_nat (a b : UInt64) (h : b ≤ U64MAX - a) : (a + b).toNat = a.toNat + b.toNat := by

  have h4 : a.toNat + b.toNat ≤ U64MAX.toNat :=
    Nat.le_trans (Nat.add_le_add_left h2 _) (Nat.le_of_eq h3.symm)
  exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt h4 (by decide)
